title: pkg/bindings: send the manifest annotate subject to the server
body:
podman manifest annotate --subject works locally but does nothing when you run it with --remote. The flag is there and the command exits fine, the subject just never gets set.
The server side already handles this… it reads IndexSubject out of the request body and passes it on. The problem is on the client, ModifyOptions in the bindings had no field for it at all so there was nothing for the tunnel to send. 
This adds the field with the json name the server expects and regenerates the setters with go generate and forwards the value.
I added a test in pkg/bindings/manifests/types_test.go that checks the subject goes out as "subject" and that an unset one does not get sent.
